description: A list of an empty and a non-empty list of lists is an error for its type with dynamic innermost
notes: The argument's type, a list of lists of lists of strings, matches the parameter's list of lists of lists of the dynamic pseudo-type (spec.md#type-specifications), so the call should receive it unchanged. hashicorp/hcl converts each argument to its parameter's type with go-cty (FunctionCallExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go). go-cty's conversionCollectionToList (cty/convert/conversion_collection.go) gives an empty list the target's element type, here a list of the dynamic pseudo-type, and keeps the empty list's own element type only when the target's element type is the dynamic pseudo-type itself. The two converted elements then have different types, and the outer list can't be made.
reference_error: element types must all match for conversion to list
